data.gender_notes: Elzear is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἔλσειαρ, meaning 'God's help'. In the Bible, Elzear is a variant of the name Eliseus, which means 'God is my salvation'. This name is associated with the biblical prophet Elisha, who was known for his faithfulness and miraculous powers. The name Elzear carries the meaning “God's help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elzear usually hope their child will grow to embody god's help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elzear total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
